CustomField.description: Text formula that returns the generic donor tier (Entry, Mid, Major, or blank for sub-Entry) based on lifetime giving against the Lifetime_Min_Amount__c thresholds in FQS_Donor_Tier custom metadata. Lifetime giving = TotalGiftsAmount (standard NPC rollup) + FQS_Legacy_Total_Gifts_Amount__c (imported from legacy systems). Each tier's Credit_Type__c setting controls whether soft credits (TotalSoftCreditsAmount + FQS_Legacy_Soft_Credit_Total__c) are added for that tier's comparison. Returns blank when the donor is below the Entry lifetime threshold. Thresholds and Credit_Type are configured via Setup → Custom Metadata Types → FQS Donor Tier or the FQS Setup screen flow. Changing threshold or Credit_Type values recalculates this field across all Donor Gift Summary records retroactively — no redeployment or batch job required. Reports and dashboards will reflect new values immediately. Use FQS_Lifetime_Donor_Level_Name__c for donor-facing displays.
CustomField.formula: IF((TotalGiftsAmount + FQS_Legacy_Total_Gifts_Amount__c + IF(TEXT($CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Major.Credit_Type__c) = "Hard + Soft Credits", TotalSoftCreditsAmount + FQS_Legacy_Soft_Credit_Total__c, 0)) >= $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Major.Lifetime_Min_Amount__c, "Major", IF((TotalGiftsAmount + FQS_Legacy_Total_Gifts_Amount__c + IF(TEXT($CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Mid.Credit_Type__c) = "Hard + Soft Credits", TotalSoftCreditsAmount + FQS_Legacy_Soft_Credit_Total__c, 0)) >= $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Mid.Lifetime_Min_Amount__c, "Mid", IF((TotalGiftsAmount + FQS_Legacy_Total_Gifts_Amount__c + IF(TEXT($CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Entry.Credit_Type__c) = "Hard + Soft Credits", TotalSoftCreditsAmount + FQS_Legacy_Soft_Credit_Total__c, 0)) >= $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Tier__mdt.Entry.Lifetime_Min_Amount__c, "Entry", "")))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatically calculated. Shows which lifetime donor tier this donor belongs to (Entry, Mid, or Major) based on their total lifetime giving. Blank means the donor is below the Entry threshold. Your administrator controls the threshold amounts. Use the Lifetime Donor Tier Name field for reports and communications.
CustomField.label: Lifetime Donor Tier
